cards.title: Boundary-driven XXZ Liouvillian
cards.latex: dot(rho)=-i[H,rho]+sum_k(2L_k rho L_k^dagger-{L_k^dagger L_k,rho}); L_1=sqrt(epsilon)sigma_1^+, L_2=sqrt(epsilon)sigma_n^-
derived_from: standard Pauli matrices and printed boundary driving

checks.reason: The Hamiltonian, jump operators and dissipator are printed in Eqs. (1)-(3).
Dense NESS agrees with the unrelated transfer contraction to 7.3e-16 in magnetization and 2.3e-16 in current.

cards.numerical_form: complex near-diagonal amplitudes with stable tau signs

checks.reason: All generic and isotropic amplitudes are transcribed from Eqs. (6)-(7) and the isotropic paragraph.

cards.latex: C(x,y)=pi f(min(x,y),max(x,y))/(4n)+O(n^-2); J=epsilon/2; M_j=epsilon^2(n+1-2j)/4 for epsilon much less than 2pi/n

checks.reason: The complete correlation kernel and weak-coupling formulas are printed in the final isotropic paragraphs.
